{"id": "36e7638c-dfa8-4a60-9983-8f31602bfbad", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "**SM-13 reports a FAIL for `dq-sched`.** Network isolation is not enabled on its effective configuration.

- `dq-sched` has no inline `NetworkConfig`, so there is no schedule-level setting. It points to the job definition `dq-def` through `MonitoringJobDefinitionName`, so the effective network settings come from that definition.
- `dq-def` has `NetworkConfig.EnableNetworkIsolation=false`, so the monitoring containers can make outbound network calls.
- The missing inline config is not a pass. It just means the check has to follow the reference to `dq-def`.

I don't have the exact SM-13 definition, so I'm assuming it requires `EnableNetworkIsolation=true` on the effective monitoring job config. If SM-13 also looks at VPC config or has exemptions, my result could differ. You didn't provide `VpcConfig`, so I haven't evaluated it.

**Remediation:** a data quality job definition can't be modified in place. Create a new definition with `EnableNetworkIsolation=true`, then update the schedule to reference it. If the job needs to reach S3 or other services, make sure its inputs and outputs work with isolation enabled before you switch.", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
